output.headline: Pays Bay Area Community Resources up to $15,000 for after-school lead agency handoff at three schools
output.summary: Bay Area Community Resources will follow the transition steps and provide the transition materials the district's Expanded Learning Office (ExLO) needs for the After School Lead Agency role at Frick United Academy of Language, Westlake Middle School and West Oakland Middle School. The agreement runs April 1 to June 30, 2025, for up to $15,000. The start date is before the board's April 9, 2025 vote.

output.headline: Pays Oakland Public Education Fund up to $42,000 to distribute summer cluster lead stipends
output.summary: Oakland Public Education Fund will pay stipends to Summer Cluster Leads, who are designated by the district's Expanded Learning Office. The agreement runs May 1 to June 30, 2025, for up to $42,000, through the Community Schools and Student Services Department.

output.headline: Pays Oakland Public Education Fund up to $110,000 for Oakland Tech summer internship stipends

money.evidence: in an amount not to exceed $110,000.00

output.summary: The district is contracting with the Oakland Public Education Fund to support student stipends in the Exploring College Career and Community Options summer internships at Oakland Technical High School. Students can complete the internships in person or virtually, and the program supports career and college readiness. The agreement runs June 1 to June 30, 2025.

output.headline: Ratifies up to $5,000 for Ball for Life Oakland to run inclusive PE games at Oakland High
output.summary: Ball for Life Oakland LLC will lead inclusive, collaborative games for one physical education (PE) cohort twice a week at Oakland High School. It serves as an extra layer of support for students who are not currently dressing or participating in PE, and works with a mixed group of dressing and non-dressing students. The agreement runs March 3 to May 29, 2025, for up to $5,000, and the board is approving it after the start date.

output.headline: Ratifies up to $13,500 for Playworks' Recess Reboot program at Fruitvale Elementary
output.summary: Playworks will provide its Recess Reboot program plan at Fruitvale Elementary School. The agreement runs January 31 to June 30, 2025, for up to $13,500, and the board is approving it after the start date.

output.headline: Pays East Bay Consortium up to $27,500 for college and financial aid support at Madison Park Upper Campus
output.summary: East Bay Consortium (EBC) will give individualized support so eligible students apply for financial aid and postsecondary programs and graduate with clear next steps. It will work with students one on one and in small groups through senior seminars, the College Center and school-wide events. The agreement runs February 24 to May 30, 2025, for up to $27,500, paid from Measure N. Its start date is before the board's April 9, 2025 vote.

output.headline: Accepts a $34,320 Oakland Promise grant for a case manager's home visits at Castlemont High
output.summary: The district is accepting a grant from Oakland Promise under the Promise Neighborhoods initiative. It pays overtime for a case manager at Castlemont High School who makes home visits and supports students' emotional health, violence prevention and attendance. The grant covers January 1 to December 31, 2025 (Year 1).
